verdict.rationale: Riskified's documented API covers order-level fraud decisions (/decide, /submit, advise), login decisions, chargebacks and decision notifications. Nothing in the evidence shows an API for reading fraud posture, creating velocity rules, editing blocklists, or approval gates on rule changes. Model calibration is described as done by Riskified's analytics team, not exposed as a programmatic surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can read my fraud posture and manage rules and lists programmatically — propose a velocity rule, update a blocklist — with human approval gates
